reason: rejected before any sandbox: the body uses {path}, which no precondition's probe references; a precondition is how a program declares what it needs, so a body parameter that no precondition names is a program that has not said what it requires -- the states it may fire in need not bind it

refused_program.intent: Merge upstream into the current branch, resolving the shared dependency-file conflict by starting from upstream's version, preserving local additions, and not reviving lines either side removed.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with two parents
postconditions.name: merge_commit_has_two_parents

postconditions.description: the second parent of HEAD is the upstream commit
postconditions.name: second_parent_is_upstream

postconditions.description: upstream is an ancestor of the new HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: no unmerged entries remain in the index
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: the working tree and index are clean after committing
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_commit

postconditions.description: no committed file contains Git conflict markers
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers_in_head

preconditions.description: the working tree and index have no changes
preconditions.name: clean_worktree

preconditions.description: no merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: both the local branch and upstream have commits the other lacks
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: exactly one file was changed on both the local and upstream sides since the merge base
preconditions.name: exactly_one_file_touched_by_both
preconditions.probe:
test "$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | wc -l)" -eq 1
